panel.text:
Q3 Planning Notes ==================
Team sync - August 2026
Action items: - Finish the migration to the new billing service by end of month - Follow up with the design team about the updated onboarding flow - Schedule a retro for the last sprint - Review open pull requests before Friday
Notes from yesterday's call: The client asked for an extension on the pilot rollout. We agreed to a two week buffer. Marketing wants updated screenshots before the next newsletter goes out.
Open questions: - Do we need a new API key for the staging environment? - Who owns the changelog for the next release?
